title: Raster River Map: Upstream Area
description: Native-grid raster of Mekong upstream contributing area at river-map cells.
purpose: Show how contributing area varies across the regional river map.
method: Convert m² to km²; mask invalid/non-positive values; YlGnBu palette with full-map logarithmic normalization by default.
data_source: Git-tracked CaMa-Flood Mekong 15-minute map; no simulation output required.
data_preparation: Inputs are already tracked; run visualization/river_map/f01-raster_river_map.sh after standard Python setup.

title: Raster River Map: Basin
description: Original positive integer basin ID raster, without renumbering or replacing IDs with display indices.
purpose: Inspect the original basin ID field and distinguish categorical basin identity from precomputed display colors.
method: One discrete bin per original integer ID; repeat tab20 colors; display-only pseudo-log categorical legend expands IDs 1-20 and compresses higher-ID intervals with representative labels; map normalization unchanged; mask missing/non-positive cells. IDs are categorical, not continuous physical quantities.
data_source: Git-tracked CaMa-Flood Mekong 15-minute map; no simulation output required.
required_data: map/mekong_15min/netcdf/basin.nc (basin, lon, lat; unitless positive integer IDs); map/mekong_15min/params.txt.
data_preparation: Tracked NetCDF input is ready. Basin preparation: map/tools/script_region/s01-regional_map.sh invokes region_set_map.F90; map/tools/script_bin2nc/s02-convert_netcdf.sh prepares individual NetCDF files. Run visualization/river_map/f01-raster_river_map.sh.

title: Raster River Map: Basin Color
description: Precomputed categorical display colors assigned to river basins on the Mekong map.
purpose: Show precomputed basin display indices as a soft background suitable for future overlays while retaining region boundaries.
method: Display bsncol directly with discrete bins for indices 1-10; mix tab10 RGB with 60% opaque white for distinguishable pastel backgrounds; no physical scale or logarithmic normalization.
data_source: Git-tracked CaMa-Flood Mekong 15-minute map; no simulation output required.
data_preparation: Tracked input is ready. map/tools/code/region_set_map.F90, invoked by map/tools/script_region/s01-regional_map.sh, derives display colors using basin information and neighboring-color checks. Run visualization/river_map/f01-raster_river_map.sh.

title: Line River Map: Connectivity Type
description: Every valid nextxy connection between river-cell centers; local D8 links are straight blue arrows and Flexible Downstream links are curved orange arrows.
purpose: Show explicit local and Flexible Downstream connectivity in the CaMa-Flood river network.
method: Draw every valid one-based nextxy source-to-destination link as a directed arrow. Local D8 links are blue and straight; nonlocal Flexible Downstream links are orange and curved. Faint logarithmic uparea raster; no extent-based filtering.
data_source: Git-tracked CaMa-Flood Mekong 15-minute map; no station data or simulation output required.
required_data: map/mekong_15min/netcdf/uparea.nc (uparea, m2); map/mekong_15min/netcdf/nextxy_noedge.nc (nextx, nexty; one-based destination indices); map/mekong_15min/params.txt (grid geometry).
data_preparation: Run visualization/river_map/f02-line_river_map.sh after standard Python setup. Both panels draw every valid link; axes clip the display without filtering connectivity.

title: Line River Map: Upstream Area
description: Every valid nextxy connection colored and width-scaled by its source cell's upstream drainage area; flexible links are curved.
purpose: Show how source-cell contributing area varies across the directed river network.
method: Draw every valid one-based nextxy link; encode source-cell uparea by logarithmic arrow color and width. Local links are straight and flexible links curved; faint logarithmic uparea raster; no extent-based filtering.
data_source: Git-tracked CaMa-Flood Mekong 15-minute map; no station data or simulation output required.
required_data: map/mekong_15min/netcdf/uparea.nc (uparea, m2); map/mekong_15min/netcdf/nextxy_noedge.nc (nextx, nexty; one-based destination indices); map/mekong_15min/params.txt (grid geometry).
data_preparation: Run visualization/river_map/f02-line_river_map.sh after standard Python setup. Both panels draw every valid link; axes clip the display without filtering connectivity.
